H5200.def: a Netophathite, or inhabitant of Netophah

H5203.def: properly, to pound, i.e. smite; by implication (as if beating out, and thus expanding) to disperse; also, to thrust off, down, out or upon (inclusively, reject, let alone, permit, remit, etc.)
H5203.kjv: cast off, drawn, let fall, forsake, join (battle), leave (off), lie still, loose, spread (self) abroad, stretch out, suffer.

H5204.derivation: a doubtful word; apparently from H5091 (נָהָה);

H5207.def: properly, restful, i.e. pleasant; abstractly, delight

H5212.def: Nisan, the first month of the Jewish sacred year

H5214.derivation: a root probably identical with that of H5216 (נִיר), through the idea of the gleam of a fresh furrow;

H5215.def: properly, plowing, i.e. (concretely) freshly plowed land

H5216.derivation: or נִר; also נֵיר; or נֵר; or (feminine) נֵרָה; from a primitive root (see H5214 (נִיר); H5135 (נוּר)) properly, meaning to glisten;
H5216.def: a lamp (i.e. the burner) or light (literally or figuratively)

H5219.def: properly, a smiting, i.e. (concretely) an aromatic gum (perhaps styrax) (as powdered)

H5220.derivation: from an unused root meaning to propagate;

H5221.def: to strike (lightly or severely, literally or figuratively)
H5221.kjv: beat, cast forth, clap, give (wounds), [idiom] go forward, [idiom] indeed, kill, make (slaughter), murderer, punish, slaughter, slay(-er, -ing), smite(-r, -ing), strike, be stricken, (give) stripes, [idiom] surely, wound.

H5226.derivation: from an unused root meaning to be straightforward;
H5226.def: properly, the fore part; used adverbially, opposite

H5227.def: properly, the front part; used adverbially (especially with preposition), opposite, in front of, forward, in behalf of

H5228.def: straightforward, i.e. (figuratively), equitable, correct, or (abstractly), integrity

H5229.def: properly, straightforwardness, i.e. (figuratively) integrity, or (concretely) a truth

H5233.derivation: from an unused root meaning to accumulate;

H5234.def: properly, to scrutinize, i.e. look intently at; hence (with recognition implied), to acknowledge, be acquainted with, care for, respect, revere, or (with suspicion implied), to disregard, ignore, be strange toward, reject, resign, dissimulate (as if ignorant or disowning)
H5234.kjv: acknowledge, [idiom] could, deliver, discern, dissemble, estrange, feign self to be another, know, take knowledge (notice), perceive, regard, (have) respect, behave (make) self strange(-ly).

H5236.def: foreign, or (concretely) a foreigner, or (abstractly) heathendom

H5237.def: strange, in a variety of degrees and applications (foreign, non-relative, adulterous, different, wonderful)

H5241.def: Nemuel, the name of two Israelites

H5242.def: a Nemuelite, or descendant of Nemuel

H5244.def: an ant (probably from its almost bisected form)

H5246.derivation: from an unused root meaning properly, to filtrate, i.e. be limpid (comp H5247 (נִמְרָה) and H5249 (נִמְרִים)); and thus to spot or stain as if by dripping;

H5247.derivation: from the same as H5246 (נָמֵר); clear water;
H5247.def: Nimrah, a place East of the Jordan
H5247.kjv: Nimrah. See also H1039 (בֵּית נִמְרָה), H5249 (נִמְרִים).

H5248.derivation: or נִמְרֹד; probably of foreign origin;

H5249.derivation: plural of a masculine corresponding to H5247 (נִמְרָה); clear waters;
H5249.def: Nimrim, a place East of the Jordan

H5251.def: a flag; also a sail; by implication, a flagstaff; generally a signal; figuratively, a token

H5252.def: properly, an environment, i.e. circumstance or turn of affairs

H5253.kjv: departing away, remove, take (hold), turn away.

H5254.def: to test; by implication, to attempt

H5257.def: properly, something poured out, i.e. a libation; also a molten image; by implication, a prince (as anointed)

H5258.def: to pour out, especially a libation, or to cast (metal); by analogy, to anoint aking
H5258.kjv: cover, melt, offer, (cause to) pour (out), set (up).

H5259.derivation: a primitive root (probably identical with H5258 (נָסַךְ) through the idea of fusion);

H5262.def: a libation; also a cast idol

H5264.derivation: a primitive root; to gleam from afar, i.e. to be conspicuous as a signal; or rather perhaps a denominative from H5251 (נֵס) (and identical with H5263 (נָסַס), through the idea of a flag as fluttering in the wind);

H5265.def: properly, to pull up, especially the tent-pins, i.e. start on ajourney
H5265.kjv: cause to blow, bring, get, (make to) go (away, forth, forward, onward, out), (take) journey, march, remove, set aside (forward), [idiom] still, be on his (go their) way.

H5271.derivation: or נָעֻר; and (feminine) נְעֻרָה; properly, passive participle from H5288 (נַעַר) as denominative;
H5271.def: (only in plural collectively or emphatic form) youth, the state (juvenility) or the persons (young people)

H5272.derivation: from H5128 (נוּעַ) and H410 (אֵל); moved of God;

H5273.def: delightful (objective or subjective, literal or figurative)

H5274.derivation: a primitive root; also denominative from H5275 (נַעַל)
H5274.def: properly, to fasten up, i.e. with abar or cord; hence, to sandal, i.e. furnish with slippers
H5274.kjv: bolt, inclose, lock, shoe, shut up.

H5275.def: properly, a sandal tongue; by extension a sandal or slipper (sometimes as a symbol of occupancy, a refusal to marry, or of something valueless)

H5276.kjv: pass in beauty, be delight, be pleasant, be sweet.

H5278.def: agreeableness, i.e. delight, suitableness, splendor or grace

H5279.def: Naamah, the name of an antediluvian woman, of an Ammonitess, and of a place in Palestine

H5280.def: a Naamanite, or descendant of Naaman (collectively)

H5283.def: Naaman, the name of an Israelite and of a Damascene

H5284.derivation: patrial from a place corresponding in name (but not identical) with H5279 (נַעֲמָה);
H5284.def: a Naamathite, or inhabitant of Naamah

H5285.derivation: from an unused root meaning to prick;
H5285.def: probably a brier; by implication, a thicket of thorny bushes

H5287.derivation: a primitive root (probably identical with H5286 (נָעַר), through the idea of the rustling of mane, which usually accompanies the lion's roar);
H5287.kjv: shake (off, out, self), overthrow, toss up and down.

H5288.def: (concretely) a boy (as active), from the age of infancy to adolescence; by implication, a servant; also (by interch. of sex), a girl (of similar latitude in age)
H5288.kjv: babe, boy, child, damsel (from the margin), lad, servant, young (man).

H5289.derivation: from H5287 (נָעַר) in its derivative sense of tossing about;

H5292.def: Naarah, the name of an Israelitess, and of a place in Palestine

H5294.derivation: from H5288 (נַעַר) and H3050 (יָהּ); servant of Jah;
H5294.def: Nearjah, the name of two Israelites

H5296.def: something shaken out, i.e. tow (as the refuse of flax)

H5297.def: Noph, the capital of Upper Egypt

H5298.derivation: from an unused root probably meaning to spring forth; a sprout;
H5298.def: Nepheg, the name of two Israelites

H5299.derivation: from H5130 (נוּף) in the sense of lifting;
